answer.sql:
WITH claim_totals AS (
    SELECT
        ca.Claim_Identifier,
        SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS loss_payment_amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS loss_reserve_amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS expense_payment_amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS expense_reserve_amount
    FROM Claim_Amount ca
    LEFT JOIN Loss_Payment lp USING (Claim_Amount_Identifier)
    LEFT JOIN Loss_Reserve lr USING (Claim_Amount_Identifier)
    LEFT JOIN Expense_Payment ep USING (Claim_Amount_Identifier)
    LEFT JOIN Expense_Reserve er USING (Claim_Amount_Identifier)
    GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
),
claim_policies AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        cc.Claim_Identifier,
        pcd.Policy_Identifier
    FROM Claim_Coverage cc
    JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
      ON pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
     AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
),
policy_premiums AS (
    SELECT
        pa.Policy_Identifier,
        SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS premium_amount
    FROM Premium pr
    JOIN Policy_Amount pa
      ON pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY pa.Policy_Identifier
),
policy_parties AS (
    SELECT
        Agreement_Identifier AS Policy_Identifier,
        STRING_AGG(DISTINCT CAST(Party_Identifier AS VARCHAR), ', ')
            FILTER (WHERE REGEXP_MATCHES(UPPER(Party_Role_Code), 'POLICY.?HOLDER|INSURED|^PH$'))
            AS policy_holder_party_identifier,
        STRING_AGG(DISTINCT CAST(Party_Identifier AS VARCHAR), ', ')
            FILTER (WHERE REGEXP_MATCHES(UPPER(Party_Role_Code), 'AGENT|PRODUCER|^AG$'))
            AS agent_party_identifier
    FROM Agreement_Party_Role
    GROUP BY Agreement_Identifier
)
SELECT
    c.Company_Claim_Number AS claim_number,
    p.Policy_Number AS policy_number,
    pp.policy_holder_party_identifier,
    COALESCE(ct.loss_payment_amount, 0) AS loss_payment_amount,
    COALESCE(ct.loss_reserve_amount, 0) AS loss_reserve_amount,
    COALESCE(ct.expense_payment_amount, 0) AS expense_payment_amount,
    COALESCE(ct.expense_reserve_amount, 0) AS expense_reserve_amount,
    COALESCE(pm.premium_amount, 0) AS premium_amount,
    pp.agent_party_identifier
FROM Claim c
JOIN claim_policies cp
  ON cp.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
JOIN Policy p
  ON p.Policy_Identifier = cp.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN claim_totals ct
  ON ct.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN policy_premiums pm
  ON pm.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN policy_parties pp
  ON pp.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
ORDER BY c.Company_Claim_Number, p.Policy_Number;

answer.sql:
SELECT
    p.Policy_Number,
    apr.Party_Identifier AS Agent_ID
FROM Policy AS p
JOIN Agreement_Party_Role AS apr
    ON apr.Agreement_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
WHERE UPPER(apr.Party_Role_Code) = 'AGENT';

SELECT
    p.Policy_Number,
    AVG(date_diff('day', c.Claim_Open_Date, c.Claim_Close_Date)) AS Average_Days_To_Settle
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        cc.Claim_Identifier,
        pcd.Policy_Identifier
    FROM Claim_Coverage AS cc
    JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail AS pcd
      ON cc.Effective_Date = pcd.Effective_Date
     AND cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
) AS cp
JOIN Claim AS c
  ON cp.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
JOIN Policy AS p
  ON cp.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
WHERE c.Claim_Open_Date IS NOT NULL
  AND c.Claim_Close_Date IS NOT NULL
  AND c.Claim_Close_Date >= c.Claim_Open_Date
GROUP BY p.Policy_Number
ORDER BY p.Policy_Number;

SELECT
    c.Company_Claim_Number,
    COALESCE(SUM(ca.Claim_Amount), 0) AS Total_Loss
FROM Claim AS c
LEFT JOIN Claim_Amount AS ca
    ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
   AND (
       EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Loss_Payment AS lp WHERE lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier)
       OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Loss_Reserve AS lr WHERE lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier)
       OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Expense_Payment AS ep WHERE ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier)
       OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Expense_Reserve AS er WHERE er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier)
   )
GROUP BY c.Company_Claim_Number
ORDER BY c.Company_Claim_Number;

SELECT
    (SELECT SUM(pa.Policy_Amount)
     FROM Premium AS pr
     JOIN Policy_Amount AS pa
       ON pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier)
    / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Policy), 0) AS Average_Policy_Size;

SELECT DISTINCT
    p.Policy_Number,
    c.Company_Claim_Number
FROM Policy AS p
JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail AS pcd
    ON pcd.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
JOIN Claim_Coverage AS cc
    ON cc.Effective_Date = pcd.Effective_Date
   AND cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
JOIN Claim AS c
    ON c.Claim_Identifier = cc.Claim_Identifier
ORDER BY p.Policy_Number, c.Company_Claim_Number;

        cc.Claim_Identifier

    UNION ALL

),

        ca.Claim_Identifier,

   AND UPPER(REGEXP_REPLACE(apr.Party_Role_Code, '[^A-Za-z0-9]', '', 'g')) = 'POLICYHOLDER'

       OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Expense_Payment ep WHERE ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier)
       OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Expense_Reserve er WHERE er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier)
    GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier

        cc.Claim_Identifier,
        p.Policy_Identifier,
        p.Policy_Number
    FROM Claim_Coverage cc
    JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
      ON pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
     AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
    JOIN Policy p

)

        Agreement_Identifier AS Policy_Identifier,
        Party_Identifier

answer.sql:
WITH premiums AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(pa.Policy_Identifier, pcd.Policy_Identifier) AS Policy_Identifier,
           SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS Premium_Amount
    FROM Premium pr
    JOIN Policy_Amount pa
      ON pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
      ON pcd.Effective_Date = pa.Effective_Date
     AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pa.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
    GROUP BY 1
),
policy_claims AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT pcd.Policy_Identifier, cc.Claim_Identifier
    FROM Claim_Coverage cc
    JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
      ON pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
     AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
),
losses AS (
    SELECT pc.Policy_Identifier,
           SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS Loss_Amount
    FROM policy_claims pc
    JOIN Claim_Amount ca
      ON ca.Claim_Identifier = pc.Claim_Identifier
    JOIN Loss_Payment lp
      ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY pc.Policy_Identifier
)
SELECT p.Policy_Number,
       apr.Party_Identifier AS Agent_ID,
       COALESCE(l.Loss_Amount, 0) / NULLIF(pr.Premium_Amount, 0) AS Loss_Ratio
FROM Policy p
JOIN Agreement_Party_Role apr
  ON apr.Agreement_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
 AND UPPER(apr.Party_Role_Code) = 'AGENT'
LEFT JOIN premiums pr
  ON pr.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN losses l
  ON l.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
GROUP BY p.Policy_Identifier, p.Policy_Number, apr.Party_Identifier,
         l.Loss_Amount, pr.Premium_Amount;

    LEFT JOIN Expense_Payment AS ep USING (Claim_Amount_Identifier)
    LEFT JOIN Expense_Reserve AS er USING (Claim_Amount_Identifier)
    GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
),
premiums AS (
    SELECT
        pa.Policy_Identifier,
        SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS premium_amount
    FROM Premium AS pr
    JOIN Policy_Amount AS pa USING (Policy_Amount_Identifier)
    GROUP BY pa.Policy_Identifier
),
policy_parties AS (
    SELECT
        Agreement_Identifier AS Policy_Identifier,
        STRING_AGG(DISTINCT CAST(Party_Identifier AS VARCHAR), ', ')
            FILTER (WHERE UPPER(Party_Role_Code) LIKE '%HOLDER%'
                       OR UPPER(Party_Role_Code) LIKE '%INSURED%') AS policy_holder_identifiers,
        STRING_AGG(DISTINCT CAST(Party_Identifier AS VARCHAR), ', ')
            FILTER (WHERE UPPER(Party_Role_Code) LIKE '%AGENT%'
                       OR UPPER(Party_Role_Code) LIKE '%PRODUCER%') AS agent_identifiers
    FROM Agreement_Party_Role
    GROUP BY Agreement_Identifier
)
SELECT
    c.Company_Claim_Number AS claim_number,
    c.Company_Subclaim_Number AS subclaim_number,
    cp.Policy_Number AS policy_number,
    pp.policy_holder_identifiers,
    pr.premium_amount,
    cat.Catastrophe_Name AS catastrophe,
    pp.agent_identifiers,
    a.loss_payment_amount,
    a.loss_reserve_amount,
    a.expense_payment_amount,
    a.expense_reserve_amount
FROM Claim AS c
LEFT JOIN claim_policies AS cp
  ON cp.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN claim_amounts AS a
  ON a.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN premiums AS pr
  ON pr.Policy_Identifier = cp.Policy_Identifier

  ON cat.Catastrophe_Identifier = c.Catastrophe_Identifier
ORDER BY c.Company_Claim_Number, c.Company_Subclaim_Number, cp.Policy_Number;

)

       ph.policy_holder_identifier,

WITH policy_claims AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.Policy_Number, cc.Claim_Identifier
    FROM Claim_Coverage AS cc
    JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail AS pcd
      ON pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
     AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
    JOIN Policy AS p
      ON p.Policy_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Identifier
),
claim_losses AS (
    SELECT ca.Claim_Identifier, SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS total_loss
    FROM Claim_Amount AS ca
    WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Loss_Payment AS x WHERE x.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier)
       OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Loss_Reserve AS x WHERE x.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier)
       OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Expense_Payment AS x WHERE x.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier)
       OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Expense_Reserve AS x WHERE x.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier)
    GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
),
losses_by_policy AS (
    SELECT pc.Policy_Number,
           COUNT(*) AS number_of_claims,
           COALESCE(SUM(cl.total_loss), 0) AS total_loss
    FROM policy_claims AS pc
    LEFT JOIN claim_losses AS cl
      ON cl.Claim_Identifier = pc.Claim_Identifier
    GROUP BY pc.Policy_Number
),
premiums_by_policy AS (
    SELECT p.Policy_Number, SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS premium
    FROM Policy AS p
    JOIN Policy_Amount AS pa
      ON pa.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
    JOIN Premium AS pr
      ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY p.Policy_Number
)
SELECT pn.Policy_Number,
       COALESCE(l.number_of_claims, 0) AS number_of_claims,
       COALESCE(l.total_loss, 0) AS total_loss,
       COALESCE(pr.premium, 0) AS premium,
       COALESCE(l.total_loss, 0) / NULLIF(pr.premium, 0) AS loss_ratio
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT Policy_Number FROM Policy) AS pn
LEFT JOIN losses_by_policy AS l
  ON l.Policy_Number IS NOT DISTINCT FROM pn.Policy_Number
LEFT JOIN premiums_by_policy AS pr
  ON pr.Policy_Number IS NOT DISTINCT FROM pn.Policy_Number
ORDER BY pn.Policy_Number;

SELECT
    c.Company_Claim_Number AS claim_number,
    COALESCE(SUM(ca.Claim_Amount), 0) AS loss_payment_amount
FROM Claim AS c
LEFT JOIN Claim_Amount AS ca
    ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Loss_Payment AS lp
    ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
WHERE lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.Company_Claim_Number
ORDER BY c.Company_Claim_Number;

FROM Policy;
